scope: Historical fixture-based RAMFS capacity regression; not proof for genuine RAMFS with the stock stat applet; no deployment authorization

guard.zero_accounting_exception: statfs type ramfs and Total/Free/Available all zero; not a tmpfs mount-name exception
guard.reclaimable_ram: MemFree + Buffers + Cached - Shmem - Unevictable; without both accounting fields, MemFree + Buffers only

regressions: mocked ramfs stat label plus zero blocks reaches read-only diagnose
unknown filesystem or partial/malformed/failed stat/df remains blocked
low RAM or missing work-budget headroom remains blocked
unevictable RAMFS pages are not reclaimed twice
limitation: The fixture said ramfs; the real stock BusyBox stat -f reports romfs on genuine RAMFS. These passing tests did not catch that alias incompatibility.
